topic: Integrating proof of play data into metrics
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on integrating 'proof of play' (POP) data into core metric calculations, specifically for campaigns. It was decided that the `core.campaign_proof_of_play` table should be cleared (`truncate`) to load all POP data.

Regarding the methodology, it was noted that POP data needs careful consideration regarding how it affects impression and reach calculations. The consensus shifted toward consulting with the Data Team for proper implementation rather than relying on assumptions.
decisions: The `core.campaign_proof_of_play` table will be cleared (truncated) to load all proof of play data.
action_items: Consult with the Data Team regarding the proper implementation and calculation method for Proof of Play metrics.
Create a ticket requesting clarification on POP integration.
